roast: Marriott turned its homepage into a hotel buffet: the booking form is the main course, and the deals keep arriving whether you asked or not.
fix: Optimize and lazy-load the image-heavy promotional cards to speed up the mobile experience, where Lighthouse performance is only 29.

notes.agent_readiness: Ora rates Marriott 25/100 (F), citing missing MCP and OpenAPI support alongside weak agent-facing access and usability.
